text:
jess_peopleops: Hi team — quick heads up, Liam (UK -> US remote) noticed double withholding on his Aug payrun. Can someone confirm what's going on?

sam_lee: Oof. He emailed earlier. Says both HMRC PAYE and US federal/state were taken in the same period.

ben_payroll: putting on vendor queue now. I see two payruns: one from our UK payroll feed (payslip id `UK-PR-48291`) and one from US payroll (id `US-PR-48291`) after his relocation entry. Looks like the UK record wasn't closed before the US hire was created.

alex_finance: thanks Ben. Do we have the employee's UK leaving docs (P45) on file? That would confirm stop date for PAYE.

liam.jayson: @jess_peopleops yes attached my P45 in the support ticket, and I completed a W-4 on my US start date. I can re-upload if needed. I noticed net pay was ~35% lower this month.

jess_peopleops: @liam.jayson thanks — we have the ticket but uploading again helps. @ben_payroll can you share the payrun snippet that's causing overlap?

ben_payroll: here's the payrun meta we pulled: ```payrun_id: UK-PR-48291
employee_id: 48291
period_end: 2025-08-15
status: posted``` and the US one ```payrun_id: US-PR-48291
period_end: 2025-08-15
status: posted``` — same period_end. Looks like a timing issue on the vendor sync.

payroll-bot: Automated note: duplicate tax-withholding pattern detected for employee 48291. Suggested actions: reverse older payrun OR process manual refund and reissue.

tanvi_hr: From policy side: when someone relocates mid-month we should close payroll in the origin country effective date of move. We also require proof of tax residency change. Liam provided P45 and new address, so policy met.

alex_finance: Can we do a manual refund for the UK PAYE portion or reissue the UK payslip as leaver? Which is quicker for employee cashflow?

ben_payroll: Short term: we can process a one-off gross-up refund on the next US payrun to correct net cash. Long term: vendor needs to cancel the UK posted payslip and refund via PAYE adjustments so HMRC records match. I'll open an expedited ticket with the vendor and flag for retrospective corrections.

jess_peopleops: Action items: 1) @liam.jayson re-upload P45 & confirm move date in ticket (he did) 2) @ben_payroll open expedited vendor ticket and tell them to cancel UK posted payslip + advise on HMRC refund steps 3) @alex_finance approve a one-off gross-up on next US payroll so Liam isn't out of pocket. Can we target next run?

alex_finance: Approve on my side for a one-off gross-up. Please include GL impact note and idempotency check so we don't double-credit.

ben_payroll: will do. I'll attach vendor ticket id and ETA once created. ETA currently 2-5 business days for cancellation; gross-up can go next US run (2025-09-01).

jess_peopleops: Great. @payroll-bot please remind me in 72h if there's no vendor update. :thumbsup:

payroll-bot: Reminder set for 72 hours (due 1759252434).

sam_lee: Thanks everyone. Liam — we'll DM you with next steps and confirm cash movement. Sorry about the hassle.

liam.jayson: Appreciate it, thanks all.

ben_payroll: vendor ticket created: VEND-99823, linked to internal ticket PO-2467. Will post updates here.

jess_peopleops: Closing loop: once vendor confirms UK cancellation and finance confirms gross-up executed, we'll log the incident for a process tweak: require explicit payroll-closure flag when geo changes within same payroll period.

sam_lee: Agreed — add to retro action items for payroll/people-ops playbook.

jess_peopleops: Thanks team.
